all fixture analysis remains local, without page/worker requests or persisted reports

specs.title: real ZIP picker preserves the mixed package and asks for an explicit executable
native folder input preserves relative paths including empty resources
empty, corrupt and ZIP-slip inputs fail cleanly with no partial filesystem
package explorer paginates and does not silently expand a nested archive
real worker preserves every file hash at the adapter package boundary
page and worker traffic carry no names or bytes; no storage or script execution occurs
cancelling a real extraction terminates its worker and a fresh package still imports
header-based candidate, keyboard override and reset never enable Run
ambiguous ZIP asks for entrypoint, then replans for the chosen executable
imports missing dependencies, edits limits and exports a local JSON profile without content
unsupported EXE, MSI, ELF, Mac, ISO and 64-bit Windows retain inspection and profile export
invalid imports preserve a working profile, reject forged verification and recover on reset
a profile can be imported before files and reload clears its temporary state
COM confirmation remains separate from static recognition, and corrupt input remains invalid
hostile PE, disk and ZIP inputs stay inert and recover without leaking metadata
refresh during actual DOS execution destroys the worker and does not restore temporary files
